discover.title: Discover
discover.damaged: The file of followed sources could not be read. You can set it aside (a copy is kept next to it) and start again with no sources.
discover.needsLibrary: Open a library to discover related work.

readnext.intro: Works cited by several documents of your library that you do not have yet. Computed on this computer from the stored citations: nothing goes online and no AI is used.
readnext.empty: Nothing to recommend with these settings.
readnext.few_one: Only {{count}} document has stored citations so far, so there is little to compare.
readnext.few_other: Only {{count}} documents have stored citations so far, so there is little to compare.
readnext.fewHint: Refresh citations to fetch more; lowering the minimum also helps.
readnext.none: Refresh the citations of your library to see what to read next.
readnext.why: Why: cited by {{count}} of your documents

watch.intro: Works found by the sources you follow. Nothing is checked in the background: use “Check now” when you want to look.
watch.empty: Nothing new. Use “Check now” to look.
watch.noSources: You follow no sources yet. Follow an author, topic or venue to see new work here.

published.intro: Preprints of your library that may now have a published version. Nothing changes until you confirm a proposal.
published.alreadyOwned: Another document of your library already has this DOI: this may be that document, so applying is not offered.
published.ownOnlyHint: Uses the author names of your profile (Settings).
published.checked: {{checked}} documents checked, {{count}} proposals, {{failed}} could not be checked.
published.notChecked: Not looked up yet. Nothing is checked until you ask.

sources.intro: What you follow. Checks run only when you ask, from the New tab.
sources.queryHint_author: An OpenAlex author id (like A123) or a name.
sources.queryHint_venue: A venue name or an OpenAlex source id (like S123).
sources.queryHint_own-preprint: Uses the author names of your profile.
sources.label: Label
sources.labelHint: Optional; shown instead of the query.
sources.title: Followed sources

discover.refreshHint: Uses the network: fetches the citations of your documents in the background.
discover.pruneNone: No search is older than 90 days.
discover.pruneConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} search older than 90 days? Their lists go with them.
discover.pruneConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} searches older than 90 days? Their lists go with them.

new.hint_question: From a question: looks in the library and on OpenAlex, ✦ summary on request
new.hint_extend: Extend the bibliography: finds works that cite or are cited by these documents, once
new.hint_bridge: Find a bridge: a work that links two papers or two sets
new.question: Your question

searches.intro: Searches you ran. The list needs no Claude and downloads nothing: works are found on OpenAlex and ranked from citations; you decide what to import.
searches.empty: Use “New search” to look for work from a question, to extend a bibliography, or to find a bridge between two papers.
searches.removeBody: Delete “{{name}}” and its list? Nothing in your library changes.
searches.reason_path: on the shortest path between them
searches.imported: “{{title}}” was added as a reference without a file.
searches.noId: This work has no DOI or arXiv id to import from; open its page instead.
searches.noCandidates: No candidate found. Try a wider question or other documents.
searches.noCandidatesBridge: No work cites or is cited by both.
searches.noBridgeWhy: The closest candidates share only the general topic. Try two wider sets (projects or tags), or
searches.offline: There is no connection: nothing can be searched online now. Only your library was searched.
searches.sumWhat: The public abstracts of the best {{count}} works (nothing of your own documents)
searches.sumDone: Summaries: {{written}} written, {{cached}} from the cache, {{none}} without an abstract.
searches.sumLater: The limit of Claude is reached: the list stays without summaries. Add them later.
